skill.description: Design, train, monitor, and evaluate reinforcement learning agents with Stable Baselines3, Gymnasium environments, callbacks, and vectorized training workflows.

content.user_title: Build Reinforcement Learning Agents with SB3
content.value_statement: Reinforcement learning projects require careful algorithm, environment, training, and evaluation choices. This skill provides Stable Baselines3 guidance and reusable templates for each stage.
actual_capabilities: Select PPO, A2C, SAC, TD3, DQN, DDPG, or HER for specific action spaces and training goals.
Design and validate custom Gymnasium environments with compatible observation, action, reset, and step interfaces.
Configure sequential or parallel vectorized environments for efficient Stable Baselines3 training.
Add evaluation, checkpoint, early stopping, progress, and custom callbacks to training workflows.
Save, load, compare, evaluate, and record trained agents with normalization support.
limitations: The skill provides guidance and templates but does not run experiments without an available Python environment.
Example scripts use PPO defaults and require adaptation for other algorithms or task-specific policies.
Suggested hyperparameters are starting points, not validated settings for every environment.
Training speed and results depend on installed dependencies, compute resources, reward design, and environment quality.

use_cases.title: Learn RL Workflows
use_cases.description: Build a first Stable Baselines3 agent and understand training, persistence, and evaluation steps.

use_cases.title: Develop Custom Environments
use_cases.description: Create Gymnasium environments with valid spaces, rewards, termination rules, and Stable Baselines3 checks.

use_cases.title: Scale Controlled Experiments
use_cases.description: Combine vectorized environments, callbacks, checkpoints, normalization, and repeatable evaluation for research experiments.

prompt_templates.title: Train a First Agent
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Stable Baselines3 plan for [environment]. Recommend an algorithm, policy, training length, evaluation method, and model-saving workflow.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a standard Gymnasium environment

prompt_templates.title: Design a Custom Environment
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Gymnasium environment for [task]. Define observations, actions, rewards, termination, truncation, seeding, validation, and a Stable Baselines3 training approach.

prompt_templates.title: Configure Parallel Training
prompt_templates.prompt: Configure Stable Baselines3 training for [task] with [environment count] environments. Choose a vectorization method and explain callback frequency, normalization, and resource tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose an RL Experiment
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Stable Baselines3 experiment: [details]. Diagnose unstable learning, propose measurements, refine callbacks and hyperparameters, and define a reproducible comparison protocol.

output_examples.input: Choose an algorithm for a discrete CartPole task with four parallel environments.
output: Recommendation: PPO with an MLP policy.
Use four vectorized environments and adjust callback frequencies by the environment count.
Evaluate on a separate environment and save the best checkpoint.

output_examples.input: Outline a custom environment for warehouse navigation.
output: Observation: normalized robot position, goal position, and nearby obstacles.
Reward: progress toward the goal, collision penalty, and completion reward.
Validation: seed resets, check every returned value, then run the Stable Baselines3 environment checker.

output_examples.input: Explain how to compare two trained policies.
output_examples.output: Evaluate both policies with identical environments, seeds, episode counts, and deterministic settings. Report mean reward, reward variation, failures, and recording evidence.

best_practices: Validate every custom environment before training and verify returned shapes, data types, bounds, and termination behavior.
Use separate evaluation environments, fixed seeds, periodic checkpoints, and consistent metrics for meaningful comparisons.
Save normalization statistics with models and restore them with evaluation updates disabled.
anti_patterns: Do not select algorithms without checking action-space support, data efficiency, and parallelization needs.
Do not evaluate on the training environment or compare runs with different episode settings.
Do not treat example hyperparameters as production settings without measuring stability, memory use, and reward variance.

faq.question: Which algorithms does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers PPO, A2C, SAC, TD3, DQN, DDPG, and HER selection and workflow guidance.

faq.question: Can it help create custom Gymnasium environments?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers spaces, reset and step methods, rewards, termination, seeding, rendering, registration, and validation.

faq.question: Does the skill run training automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and Python templates that require installed dependencies and suitable compute resources.

faq.question: Does it support parallel environments?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains DummyVecEnv, SubprocVecEnv, callback frequency adjustments, normalization, and off-policy considerations.

faq.question: How does it evaluate trained agents?
faq.answer: It supports repeated policy evaluation, reward statistics, model comparison, rendering, video recording, and restored normalization statistics.

faq.question: What dependencies are required?
faq.answer: Stable Baselines3 and Gymnasium are required. Video, TensorBoard, and environment features may need optional packages.
